=== THE METHODOLOGICAL RULE, NOW IN EIGHT PARTS -- APPLY ALL EIGHT ===
(i) Ask the fetch for the ENTIRE ROW / TABLE / PASSAGE / FILE VERBATIM with an explicit instruction to write 'ABSENT' or 'CANNOT READ' rather than infer; never accept a summarised 'the value is/isn't X'. (iv) PULL THE WHOLE TABLE, not the rows the claim needs. (v) A PRESENT verdict may be trusted from one fetch; an ABSENT verdict MUST be confirmed against a second URL form. Before recording ANY absence check FOUR things: the ABSTRACT; a DIFFERENT URL RENDERING; THAT YOU FETCHED THE FILE THE CLAIM ACTUALLY CITES; and THAT THE VERSION YOU FETCHED CONTAINS THE MATERIAL AT ALL. (vi) A SOURCE CAN BE CLEAN WHILE THE STATE'S ACCOUNT OF IT IS NOT: re-read what the STATE says the source shows, not only what the source says. (vii) CHECK HEDGES IN BOTH DIRECTIONS -- a hedge is a claim and must be scoped as precisely as an assertion; src-0018 passed every stored quotation and still failed because its stored scope was TOO RESTRICTIVE. (viii) NEW AT CYCLE 29, AND IT IS THE ONE THAT CAUGHT src-0008: STRING-MATCHING A CLAIM'S QUOTATIONS AND NUMBERS DOES NOT TEST ITS QUANTIFIER OR ITS SCOPE. src-0008's every stored quotation and number PASSED, and the claim still failed because it was quantified over 'current LLMs' when the paper evaluates FIVE models and the fifth refutes it.
